definitions.definition: Not imaginary; real; actual; true; veritable.

quote.citation: 1850s, Cardinal John Henry Newman, The Rise and Progress of Universities
quote.text: to do some substantial good, is the compensation for much incidental imperfection

definitions.definition: Having good substance; strong; stout; solid; firm.
Possessed of goods or an estate; moderately wealthy.
Large in size, quantity, or value; ample; significant.
Satisfying; having sufficient substance to be nourishing or filling.
Anything having substance; an essential part.
